description: Twenty-one floors of grey glass going up out of the gravel with no setback and no apology, the Halcyon eye etched at chest height on every ground-floor pane so you cannot approach the building without being looked at. Half the windows above the tenth are dark, which is not the same as empty. A brass plate by the doors lists the floors by department, ending at RETENTION, and it is polished daily by somebody whose job that is. The lobby is east; Halcyon Boulevard runs west.
name: Halcyon Towers
